description: Digest-bound PatchBundle review delivery and lifecycle over fixtures. Historical recipes traverse only as diagnostic-only system fixtures on isolated copies; no public mutation and no historical value reuse.

implementation.seam: new pure package internal/wcncpreview reusing the signed PatchBundle envelope and Java verification boundary

coverage: draft creation with all protocol sections and authority statement
accept, reject, and defer derive distinct terminal states
unsigned, malformed, or digest-mismatched PatchBundle envelopes reject before review
a missing verifier or failed signature verification rejects before review binding
the canonical JCS and Ed25519 Java verifier is exercised by the review checker
acceptance never implies source application or merge
